acceptance: Both tests pass with a populated _project/scripts/.venv present.
Both still fail on a tracked file that violates their rule (existing negative cases keep working).
context:
Found while running the leader's fast tier for batch-loop-pilot (batch-integration-loop-20261101).

2026-11-04: confirmed on four batch integration worktrees. Two local fast-tier failures came from _project/scripts/.venv sitting inside the worktree, where the guard tests scan it.

2026-11-07 (ci-and-preflight-reliability): already fixed on develop before this batch: #3971 limits test_repo_has_no_vacuous_sqlglot_overlays to git-tracked files (test_scan_ignores_untracked_files covers an untracked _project/scripts/.venv) and #3974 makes test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass skip dot-directories (a test builds a fake scripts/.venv sqlglot tree). Verified at origin/develop 766364b8a3 with a copy of a populated _project/scripts/.venv (sqlglot-30.16.0 installed) present in the worktree: tests/unit/sql_compat/test_sqlglot_overlay_guard.py and tests/unit/sql_compat/test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass.py, 50 passed; existing negative cases in both files still run. No change needed.
description: tests/unit/sql_compat/test_sqlglot_overlay_guard.py::test_repo_has_no_vacuous_sqlglot_overlays and tests/unit/sql_compat/test_vendored_sqlglot_bypass.py::test_upstream_sqlglot_imports_are_exactly_the_allowlisted_project_tools walk the filesystem, so a git-ignored `_project/scripts/.venv` (created by any `uv run --project _project/scripts`, including the batch-* targets and the todo-db tracker CLI) puts PyPI sqlglot files into their scan and both fail. Seen 2026-11-02 in `make pr-preflight-fast-tests` on the batch-loop pilot integration worktree; removing the venv made them pass. Restrict both scans to tracked files (git ls-files) or skip git-ignored directories.
